meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 装上后，它就能给 NanoClaw 配 WhatsApp 通道：先让你选专属小号还是日常个人号，再扫码或输配对码绑定。小号上收到的消息都归它；个人号上它只出现在“与自己聊天”里，别人发来的消息一律不看不回。
howto.when: 当你说“接入 WhatsApp”“连上我的 WhatsApp”这类要求，或要求给 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp 聊天渠道时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 WhatsApp 接到 NanoClaw 上
say.note: 开始添加流程，先确认用哪个号码

say.text: 用我现在日常的号码连
say.note: 它会判定为共用号码并弹出账号风险警告

say.text: 用配对码绑定一个专属小号
say.note: 按专属号流程走，引导输 8 位配对码

howto.what_en: Installed, it wires WhatsApp into NanoClaw: pick dedicated spare or daily personal number, then link via QR or pairing code. Dedicated: messages handled. Personal: agent only lives in your self-chat; others’ messages ignored.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add or connect WhatsApp to NanoClaw, e.g. “add WhatsApp” or “connect my WhatsApp”, or ask for a WhatsApp chat channel.

say_en.text: Hook my WhatsApp up to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Starts the setup flow and asks which number to use

say_en.text: Use the number I use every day
say_en.note: Treated as shared; shows the account-risk warning first

say_en.text: Pair a dedicated spare number with a code
say_en.note: Uses the dedicated flow and asks for the 8-character pairing code
